WHEREAS, the Mayor and City Council of Irwinton, Georgia are desirous of amending
1:
providing for the package sale of distilled Spirits within the corporate limits of the City of Irwinton; and

WHEREAS, a lawfully conducted referendum was held on November 8, 2022, and the registered voters of the City of Irwinton having approved by a majority vote the package sale of distilled spirits within the corporate limits of the City of Irwinton; and

NOW THEREFORE BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and City Council of Irwinton, Georgia, meeting in formal session, that the Alcoholic Beverage Section of the Irwinton Code of Ordinances be amended by adding a second paragraph to Section 3-201 to read as follows:

~ The package sale of distilled spirits having been approved by a majority vote of the registered voters for the City of Irwinton, said package sale of distilled spirits shall be permitted within the corporate limits of the City of Irwinton. The licensee shall be required to carry on their licensed premises a minimum retail inventory of distilled Spirits in the amount of $125,000.00. The sale of lottery tickets, the operation of gambling devices and any other games of chance shall not be permitted in any business licensed for the package sale of distilled spirits. Loitering laws shall be strictly enforced and violations of State or local loitering laws may be considered as a reason for the City to revoke the license for the package sale of distilled spirits. All other portions of the alcoholic beverage section of the Code of Ordinances regarding the licensure and sale of alcoholic beverages shall be incorporated herein for the purpose of the package sale of distilled spirits within the corporate limits of Irwinton, Georgia.

Providing for the license fee for the Package sale of distilled Spirits within the Corporate limits of the City of Irwinton; and

WHEREAS, a lawfully conducted referendum was held on November 8, 2022, and the registered voters of the City of Irwinton having approved bya Majority vote the package sale of distilled spirits within the corporate limits of the City of Irwinton; and

NOW THEREFORE BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and City Council of Irwinton, Georgia, meeting in formal session, that the Alcoholic Beverage Section of the Irwinton Code of Ordinances be amended by adding Section 3-203 to read as follows:

3-203 License Fee

License fees for the package sale of distilled Spirits shall be $2,500.00. In the event that a licensee shall relocate his business, the license fee paid for that year may be applied and transferred to the application for the license for the new location upon the condition that the application for new location shall be made in and for the same calendar year.
